acceptanceCriteria: docs/DOGFOOD.md and the dogfood check spec name the rule for a change whose canonical verifier output differs from the base verifier by construction (for example: a one-time check with the tree verifier in both roles, recorded as `base-independence: NOT_PROVED` with both digests, admitted only when the change's spec declares the output change), or they state explicitly that such changes must keep default output frozen and gate new members behind opt-in flags until the cutover.
V1-1276 and V1-1265 cite the chosen rule before their check/seal step.
A regression test in internal/dogfoodflow exercises the chosen rule against a tree verifier whose `cem status` stdout differs from the base verifier by one additive member.
body: Source: V1-1262 lane (decision 0523 P0), 2026-10-12, corvint at origin/main f0d0e6106. Repro: in a plain clone of claude/v1-1262-cem-tiers at 4aa61ac2a, `make dogfood-change BASE=f0d0e6106d8f7ffeaac46339ba274df3aafc712f` completes (exit 0, 48 hunks cited) but `make dogfood-check BASE=<same>` fails `dogfood-check: FAIL verifier-disagreement`. Cause: internal/dogfoodflow/check.go `agree` requires byte-identical stdout/stderr/status of `cem status` from the base-commit verifier and the tree verifier; the lane added the additive `citation` member to the canonical verification object, so the base verifier (which predates it) can never agree. Expected: a documented transition for a change whose own output differs by construction. Actual: the change cannot be checked or sealed at its own base; the workaround taken in V1-1262 is to gate emission behind an opt-in `--citation` flag so default output stays frozen. Consequence for decision 0525: the dogfood producer cutover to cem/1.0 (V1-1276) and the stable-result freeze (V1-1265) change verifier output by construction and will hit the same refusal; `corvint dogfood finish` already records the analogous no-base-independence case (LCP-V0-014). Not a request to weaken the byte-identical rule for ordinary changes.
title: dogfood-check: a change to canonical cem status output cannot pass its own base check (verifier-disagreement)
